org: Personalized Learning & Scalable Tutoring Solutions (PLUS), CMU
summary: Building and stress-testing the evaluation layer for an AI tutoring system.
bullets: Measured human and LLM annotation agreement with Cohen's kappa and Krippendorff's alpha, down to item-level disagreement analysis.
Designed an event-mapping schema that aligns multimodal tutoring transcripts with clickstream logs, validated against video.
Built the gold-standard benchmark for an LLM dialogue-act annotation system, and ran adversarial QA on AI-generated feedback in training lessons.

summary: Teaching precalculus and building the tooling around the course.
bullets: Built an interactive H5P and Edpuzzle course layer with embedded checkpoints and misconception probes.
Built an instructor dashboard in Next.js and Supabase, drawing on Canvas and Gradescope data.
Built a course-grounded LLM tutor that diagnoses missing prerequisites.

summary: Shipped a reflection intervention into a live math-learning game.
bullets: Implemented a first-attempt reflection intervention in a game built on a cognitive tutor platform.
Intercepted feedback rendering at the component level in an unfamiliar JavaScript codebase.
Preserved research-log integrity for a live study.

org: Optimized Algorithms and Knowledge (OAK) Lab, CMU
summary: Analyzed what a reflection step actually does to how students learn from an AI tutor.
bullets: Found that reflection roughly doubled time on feedback and cut practice iterations about 40%, with no performance gain.
Built an NLP pipeline scoring reflection depth, self-explanation, and error diagnosis against a human-labeled benchmark, with structured JSON output.

org: Eberly Center for Teaching Excellence & Educational Innovation, CMU
summary: Turned classroom observation into quantitative instructional data.
bullets: Ran structured observations across courses serving 200+ students, using a coding scheme that converts them into analyzable instructional data.

summary: Ran a fundraising fellowship and automated the operations behind it.
bullets: Designed and ran a pan-India fundraising fellowship that raised $5,000+ in six weeks.
Automated donor and stakeholder operations, cutting admin work about 30%.

summary: Shipped accessible onboarding UI and the research behind it.
bullets: Shipped accessible React components for an internal onboarding platform; support queries fell about 45%.
Ran user interviews and defined requirements and success metrics.

summary: Modeled multilingual STEM learning in low-resource settings.
bullets: Fit hierarchical models combining interview codes with assessments to study multilingual STEM learning in low-literacy, low-tech settings.
